Package com.here.sdk.navigation

Class AutomotiveCameraBehavior

java.lang.Object
com.here.NativeBase
com.here.sdk.navigation.AutomotiveCameraBehavior
All Implemented Interfaces:
CameraBehavior, CameraHdTransition
public final class AutomotiveCameraBehavior extends NativeBase implements CameraBehavior, CameraHdTransition

High-level camera controller for automotive navigation that delegates to either a TrackingCameraBehavior for following the vehicle or an AreaCameraBehavior for showing geographic regions. Can also be deactivated via getActiveCameraType() to release control to external code.

Configuration including animation durations, zoom policies, maneuver rules, and per-mode tilt/bearing/principal-point profiles is provided via a JSON string and validated at construction. The AreaCameraBehavior anchor is taken from the AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode.MODE_NORTH_UP principal point in the configuration.

Note: This is a beta release of this feature and may contain bugs or exhibit unexpected behaviour. Related APIs are subject to change without a deprecation process.

    • setAreaCameraBehaviorVisiblePoints

      public void setAreaCameraBehaviorVisiblePoints(@NonNull List<GeoCoordinates> points, boolean includeCurrentPosition)

      Configures the AreaCameraBehavior to show the given points in its camera view. Applied the next time getActiveCameraType() is set to AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType.AREA and overrides any previous configuration set via setAreaCameraBehaviorGeobox(com.here.sdk.core.GeoBox).

      Parameters:
      points -

      Geographic coordinates to show in the camera view.

      includeCurrentPosition -

      When true, the current vehicle position is also included in the camera view.

    • setPrincipalPointForOrientation

      public void setPrincipalPointForOrientation(@NonNull AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode mode, @NonNull Anchor2D value)

      Sets the principal point for a specific AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode. Does not require that mode to be currently active. When mode matches getOrientationMode(), the TrackingCameraBehavior is updated immediately.

      Parameters:
      mode -

      The AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode whose principal point is updated.

      value -

      Normalized principal point value for the given AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode.

    • isManeuverDetectionEnabled

      public boolean isManeuverDetectionEnabled()

      Returns true when maneuver detection is enabled.

      Reactions follow the rules defined in the JSON configuration. The initial value is taken from configuration. Changes apply immediately when AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType.TRACKING, otherwise the next time tracking is activated. Defaults to false, unless configured in JSON configuration.

      Returns:

      If enabled, the TrackingCameraBehavior reacts to upcoming maneuvers.

    • getActiveCameraType

      @NonNull public AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType getActiveCameraType()

      Gets the active camera type.

      Selects which child camera handles updates. Set to AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType.NONE to release control to external code, AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType.TRACKING for the TrackingCameraBehavior, or AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType.AREA to use the most recent framing configured via setAreaCameraBehaviorVisiblePoints(java.util.List<com.here.sdk.core.GeoCoordinates>, boolean) or setAreaCameraBehaviorGeobox(com.here.sdk.core.GeoBox). Defaults to AutomotiveCameraBehavior.ActiveCameraType.NONE.

      Returns:

      The active camera type.

    • getOrientationMode

      @NonNull public AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode getOrientationMode()

      Gets the current orientation mode.

      Selects the tilt, bearing, and principal point profile applied to the TrackingCameraBehavior. Profile values are taken from the JSON configuration. The AreaCameraBehavior always renders in AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode.MODE_NORTH_UP regardless of this property. Defaults to AutomotiveCameraBehavior.OrientationMode.MODE_3D.

      Returns:

      The current orientation mode of the TrackingCameraBehavior.

    • getViewRectangle

      @Nullable public Rectangle2D getViewRectangle()

      Gets the current view rectangle, if it's set.

      Defines a sub-space of the screen that the behavior should consider for camera updates. Using a view rectangle keeps the camera positioning consistent across different screen types and orientations without per-screen principal point adjustments. Defaults to null. If not set, it uses the viewport bounds of the underlying map view.

      Specified by:
      getViewRectangle in interface CameraBehavior
      Returns:

      The view rectangle for camera updates.

    • getMinimumHdLengthInMeters

      public int getMinimumHdLengthInMeters()

      Gets the minimum HD length in meters.

      The camera transitions from HD to SD mode when HD lane data availability falls below this distance ahead, or transitions to HD mode when sufficient HD data is detected.
